elements.name: create_grid
elements.brief: Creates a grid to find paths on.
elements.description: Creates a grid to find paths on.

parameters.name: walls
parameters.doc: Blocked cells, such as `[[10, 12], [11, 12]]`. **⚠️ 1-based; passed to `def_windward_jps` unchanged.**

functions.name: find_path
functions.brief: Finds a path between two cells. A start or goal that is outside the
functions.description:
Finds a path between two cells. A start or goal that is outside the
grid or blocked, or a goal that cannot be reached, fails with an error
message instead of a path, so check `path` before reading it.

parameters.name: start
parameters.doc: Cell to start from. **⚠️ 1-based; passed to `def_windward_jps` unchanged.**

parameters.name: goal
parameters.doc: Cell to reach. **⚠️ 1-based; passed to `def_windward_jps` unchanged.**

parameters.name: heuristic
parameters.doc: Distance estimate to search with. Default is `"octile"`.

returnvalues.doc:
`path`, the cells from start to goal, and `nil`; or `nil` and
`message`, why the search failed.

**⚠️ `path` is 1-based; passed to `def_windward_jps` unchanged.**

functions.name: is_walkable
functions.brief: Whether a cell is inside the grid and not blocked. Use it to check a
functions.description:
Whether a cell is inside the grid and not blocked. Use it to check a
cell before searching from or to it.

parameters.name: point
parameters.doc: Cell to check. **⚠️ 1-based; passed to `def_windward_jps` unchanged.**

returnvalues.doc: `true` if the cell can be walked through.
